title: Mode Choice, Energy, Emissions and the Rebound Effect in U.S. Freight Transportation
Modeling Uncertainty in Climate Policy: An Application to the US IRA
venue: Environmental and Energy Policy and the Economy
abstract: In recent years the analysis of US climate policy on the electricity sector has predominantly deployed electricity planning or capacity expansion models that use deterministic or equilibrium optimization methods. While uncertainty in key input assumptions is considered, it is usually restricted to scenario analysis. In this study we combine time-series econometric forecasting methods with an equilibrium electricity system-expansion model. The goal is to produce statistically rigorous distributions of outcomes, rather than rely upon individually selected scenarios. We apply these techniques to the case of the US Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) in the context of the western US electricity grid. The most significant power sector financial incentives are tax credits applied to eligible zero-carbon and storage resources. Our results indicate that the impact of the IRA, in terms of additional investment in low-carbon resources, depends heavily on the realization of key exogenous variables. However, the net effect of the IRA is to sharply narrow the range of future carbon emissions, largely by eliminating states of the world where investment in natural gas resources would otherwise be optimal. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 近年来，美国对电力部门气候政策的分析主要采用确定性或均衡优化方法的电力规划或装机容量扩张模型。虽然这些分析考虑了关键输入假设中的不确定性，但通常仅限于情景分析。本研究将时间序列计量预测方法与均衡电力系统扩张模型相结合。其目标是得出具有统计严谨性的结果分布，而非依赖人为挑选的若干情景。我们将这些方法应用于美国《通胀削减法案》（Inflation Reduction Act，IRA）在美国西部电网背景下的情形。电力部门最重要的财政激励是对符合条件的零碳资源和储能资源给予的税收抵免。结果表明，就低碳资源的额外投资而言，《通胀削减法案》的影响在很大程度上取决于关键外生变量的实现情况。然而，该法案的净效应是大幅收窄未来碳排放的范围，主要方式是排除那些在无该法案时天然气投资将是最优的世界状态。NBER工作论文系列的机构订阅用户及发展中国家居民，可免费从 www.nber.org 下载本文。

title: The Economics of Electricity Reliability
abstract: The physics of an electrical grid requires that the supply injected into the grid is always in balance with the quantity consumed. If that balance is not maintained, cascading outages are likely to disrupt supply to all consumers on the grid. In the past, vertically integrated monopoly utilities have ensured that supply is adequate to meet demand and maintain grid stability, but with deregulation of generation, assuring adequate supply has become much more complex. The unique characteristics of electricity distribution means that there are immense potential externalities among market participants from supply shortfalls. In this paper, we discuss the institutions that US electricity markets have developed to avoid such destabilizing supply shortfalls when there are multiple generators and retailers in the market. Though many of the markets rely on standardized requirements for supplier reserves, we conclude that recent technological progress may steer future evolution towards a system that relies to a greater extent on economic incentives.
abstract_zh: 电网的物理特性要求注入电网的供应量始终与消耗量保持平衡。若这种平衡无法维持，连锁停电很可能会中断电网上所有用户的供电。过去，纵向一体化的垄断公用事业公司确保供应足以满足需求并维持电网稳定，但随着发电领域的放松管制，保障充足供应变得复杂得多。电力配送的独特属性意味着，供应短缺会在市场参与者之间产生巨大的潜在外部性。本文讨论了美国电力市场在存在多个发电商和零售商的情况下，为避免此类破坏稳定的供应短缺而发展出的制度安排。尽管许多市场依赖于供应商备用容量的标准化要求，但我们认为，近期的技术进步可能会推动未来的演变，使系统更多地依赖经济激励。

title: The Electric Ceiling: Limits and Costs of Full Electrification
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: Electrification is a centerpiece of global decarbonization efforts. Yet there are reasons to be skeptical of the inevitability, or at least the optimal pace, of the transition. We discuss several under-appreciated costs of full, or even deep, electrification. Consumer preferences can operate in favor of and in opposition to electrification goals; and electrification is likely to encounter physical and economic obstacles when it reaches some as-yet-unknown level. While we readily acknowledge the external benefits of decarbonization, we also explore several under-appreciated external costs. The credibility and eventual success of decarbonization efforts is enhanced by foreseeing and ideally avoiding predictable but non-obvious costs of promising abatement pathways. Thus, even with all of its promise, the degree of electrification may ultimately reach a limit.
abstract_zh: 电气化是全球脱碳努力的核心。然而，有理由对这一转型的必然性，或至少其最优速度，持怀疑态度。我们讨论了完全乃至深度电气化的若干未被充分认识的成本。消费者偏好既可能有利于电气化目标，也可能与之相悖；而且，当电气化达到某个尚不确定的水平时，很可能遭遇物理和经济上的障碍。尽管我们承认脱碳的外部效益，但也探讨了若干未被充分认识的外部成本。脱碳努力的可信度和最终成功，取决于能否预见并尽可能避免有前景的减排路径中可预见但不明显的成本。因此，即便电气化前景广阔，其程度最终也可能触及上限。

title: The End of Neutrality: Fuel Standards, Technology Neutrality, and Stimulating the Electric Vehicle Market
venue: Economics of Energy and Environmental Policy

title: Do Two Electricity Pricing Wrongs Make a Right? Cost Recovery, Externalities, and Efficiency
abstract: Economists favor pricing pollution in part so that consumers face the full social marginal cost (SMC) of goods and services. But even absent externalities, retail electricity prices typically exceed private marginal cost, due to a utility’s need to cover average costs. Furthermore, the SMC of electricity can fluctuate widely hour-to-hour, while retail prices do not. We show that residential electricity rates exceed average SMC in most of the US, but there is large geographic and temporal variation. This finding has important implications for pass-through of pollution costs, as well as for policies promoting dynamic pricing, alternative energy, and reduced electricity consumption. (JEL D62, L94, L98, Q42, Q53)
abstract_zh: 经济学家赞成对污染定价，部分原因是为了使消费者面对商品和服务的完全社会边际成本（SMC）。但即使不存在外部性，零售电价通常也高于私人边际成本，这是因为公用事业公司需要弥补平均成本。此外，电力的社会边际成本可能每小时都大幅波动，而零售价格却并不随之变化。我们表明，在美国大部分地区，居民电价高于平均社会边际成本，但存在很大的地理和时间差异。这一发现对于污染成本的传导，以及对于促进动态定价、替代能源和减少电力消费的政策，都具有重要意义。（JEL分类号：D62、L94、L98、Q42、Q53）

title: Food vs. Fuel? Impacts of Petroleum Shipments on Agricultural Prices
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Grain shippers and political figures in North Dakota and nearby states have voiced concern that the dramatic increases in shipments of crude oil by rail have caused service delays and higher costs. We investigate the potential impact of crude shipments on grain markets accounting for harvest effects and other potential sources of rail congestion. Increased crude oil shipments are associated with substantially larger spreads between wheat prices at regional elevators and in Minneapolis, the market hub. The effect on corn and soybean spreads are an order of magnitude smaller. Increased oil traffic is associated with small increases in rail rates but large increases in rail car auction prices. We document increases in wheat carry (storage) costs and decreases in shipment quantities. Surprisingly, little of the spread increase is due to lower prices paid to farmers, suggesting consumers rather than producers paid the cost of increased rail congestion.
abstract_zh: 北达科他州及邻近各州的粮食托运商和政界人士担忧，原油铁路运输量的急剧增长导致了运输延误和成本上升。我们在考虑收获效应及其他可能的铁路拥堵来源的情况下，考察了原油运输对粮食市场的潜在影响。原油运输量的增加与区域粮仓小麦价格和作为市场枢纽的明尼阿波利斯小麦价格之间的价差大幅扩大相关。对玉米和大豆价差的影响则小一个数量级。石油运输量的增加与铁路运价的小幅上涨相关，但与铁路车皮拍卖价格的大幅上涨相关。我们记录了小麦仓储（储存）成本的上升以及运输量的下降。令人惊讶的是，价差扩大的部分原因很少来自农民所获价格的降低，这表明是消费者而非生产者承担了铁路拥堵加剧的成本。

title: Headwinds and Tailwinds: Implications of Inefficient Retail Energy Pricing for Energy Substitution
venue: Environmental and Energy Policy and the Economy
abstract: Electrification of transportation and buildings to reduce greenhouse gas emissions requires massive switching from natural gas and refined petroleum products. All three end-use energy sources are mispriced due in part to the unpriced pollution they emit. Natural gas and electricity utilities also face the classic natural monopoly challenge of recovering fixed costs while maintaining efficient pricing. We study the magnitude of these distortions for electricity, natural gas, and gasoline purchased by residential customers across the continental United States. We find that the net distortion in pricing electricity is much greater than for natural gas or gasoline. Residential customers in much of the country face electricity prices that are well above social marginal cost (private marginal cost plus unpriced externalities), whereas in some areas with large shares of coal-fired generation, prices are below social marginal cost. Combining our estimates of marginal price and social marginal cost for each of the fuels with a large survey of California households’ energy use, we calculate the distribution of annual fuel costs for space heating, water heating, and electric vehicles under actual pricing versus setting price at social marginal cost. We find that moving prices for all three fuels to equal their social marginal cost would significantly increase the incentive for Californians to switch to electricity for these energy services.
abstract_zh: 为减少温室气体排放，交通和建筑的电气化需要大规模地从天然气和成品石油产品转向电力。这三种终端用能来源的价格都存在扭曲，部分原因在于它们排放的污染未被定价。天然气和电力公用事业公司还面临着经典的自然垄断难题：在维持有效定价的同时回收固定成本。我们研究了美国大陆地区居民用户所购电力、天然气和汽油中这些扭曲的程度。我们发现，电力定价的净扭曲远大于天然气或汽油。全国大部分地区的居民用户所面对的电价远高于社会边际成本（私人边际成本加上未定价的外部性），而在一些燃煤发电占比较高的地区，电价则低于社会边际成本。我们将每种燃料的边际价格和社会边际成本估计值，与一项针对加利福尼亚州家庭能源使用的大规模调查相结合，计算了在实际价格下与将价格设定为社会边际成本时，空间供暖、热水和电动汽车的年度燃料成本分布。我们发现，将三种燃料的价格都调整为与其社会边际成本相等，将显著增强加州居民为这些能源服务转向使用电力的激励。

title: Energy Prices and Electric Vehicle Adoption
abstract: This paper presents evidence that gasoline prices have a larger effect on demand for electric vehicles (EVs) than electricity prices in California. We match a spatially-disaggregated panel dataset of monthly EV registration records to detailed records of gasoline and electricity prices in California from 2014-2017, and use these to estimate the effect of energy prices on EV demand. Two distinct empirical approaches (panel fixed-effects and a utility-border discontinuity) yield remarkably similar results: a given change in gasoline prices has roughly four to six times the effect on EV demand as a similar percentage change in electricity prices. We explore the implications for optimal EV subsidies, which promote externality reduction benefits and correct for consumer misoptimization stemming from the undervaluation of future electricity costs.
abstract_zh: 本文提供证据表明，在加州，汽油价格对电动汽车（EV）需求的影响大于电价。我们将2014至2017年加州按月的电动汽车注册记录（空间细分的面板数据）与详细的汽油和电价记录相匹配，并据此估计能源价格对电动汽车需求的影响。两种不同的实证方法（面板固定效应和电力公司服务区边界断点设计）得出了极为相似的结果：汽油价格的给定变动对电动汽车需求的影响，约为同等百分比电价变动影响的四至六倍。我们探讨了这一结果对最优电动汽车补贴的含义，此类补贴既能促进外部性减少带来的收益，也能纠正因低估未来电费成本而导致的消费者决策偏误。

title: Low Energy: Estimating Electric Vehicle Electricity Use
venue: American Economic Review: Papers and Proceedings
abstract: We provide the first at-scale estimate of electric vehicle (EV) home charging. Previous estimates are based on conflicting surveys or are extrapolated from a small, unrepresentative sample of households with dedicated EV meters. We combine billions of hourly electricity meter measurements with address-level EV registration records from California households, including 64,000 EV owners. The average EV increases overall household load by 2.9 kilowatt-hours per day, well under half the amount assumed by state regulators. Results imply that EVs travel less than expected on electric power, raising questions about transportation electrification for climate policy.
abstract_zh: 我们首次给出了电动汽车（EV）家庭充电的大规模估计。以往的估计要么基于相互矛盾的调查，要么是从一小批配备专用电表、缺乏代表性的家庭样本外推得出。我们将数十亿条每小时电表测量数据与加州家庭的地址级电动汽车注册记录相结合，涵盖64,000名电动汽车车主。平均而言，一辆电动汽车使家庭总负荷每天增加2.9千瓦时，远低于州监管机构假设数值的一半。研究结果表明，电动汽车使用电力的行驶里程低于预期，这对以交通电气化推进气候政策的合理性提出了疑问。

title: Setting with the Sun: The Impacts of Renewable Energy on Wholesale Power Markets
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Policies supporting investment in renewable electricity have been a cornerstone of climate policy in many parts of the world. While previous empirical work explores the economic and environmental impacts of renewable production, the focus has exclusively been on the short-run impacts of expanding renewable supply. In this paper, we shed light on the longer run impacts of renewable expansions. Focusing on the California electricity market, we estimate how wholesale electricity prices have responded to a dramatic increase in utility-scale solar capacity. While a substantial decline in daily average prices can be attributed to the solar capacity expansion, this average price impact masks a substantial decrease in mid-day prices combined with an increase in shoulder hour prices. These results imply that short-term power markets are responding to the renewable expansion in a fashion that could sustain more flexible conventional generation, while seriously undermining the economic viability of traditional baseload generation technologies.
abstract_zh: 支持可再生电力投资的政策，已成为世界许多地区气候政策的基石。尽管既有的实证研究探讨了可再生能源生产的经济与环境影响，但其关注点仅限于扩大可再生能源供应的短期影响。本文则揭示了可再生能源扩张的长期影响。我们以加利福尼亚州电力市场为研究对象，估计了批发电价如何响应公用事业规模太阳能装机容量的急剧增长。日均电价的大幅下降可归因于太阳能装机容量的扩张，但这一平均价格影响掩盖了一个现象：午间电价大幅下降，同时肩部时段电价上升。这些结果表明，短期电力市场对可再生能源扩张的反应方式，可能维持更具灵活性的传统发电，同时严重削弱传统基荷发电技术的经济可行性。

title: Expecting the Unexpected: Emissions Uncertainty and Environmental Market Design
abstract: We study potential equilibria in California’s cap-and-trade market for greenhouse gases (GHGs) based on information available before the market started. We find large ex ante uncertainty in business-as-usual emissions and in the abatement that might result from non-market policies, much larger than the reduction that could plausibly occur in response to an allowance price within a politically acceptable range. This implies that the market price is very likely to be determined by an administrative price floor or ceiling. Similar factors seem likely to be present in other cap-and-trade markets for GHGs. (JEL D47, D81, Q54, Q58, R11)
abstract_zh: 我们基于市场开始运行前可获得的信息，研究加利福尼亚州温室气体总量控制与交易市场的潜在均衡。我们发现，在一切照旧（business-as-usual）情景下的排放量以及非市场政策可能带来的减排量，事前存在很大的不确定性，其幅度远大于在政治上可接受的范围内、因配额价格变化而可能产生的减排量。这意味着市场价格很可能由行政性的价格下限或上限决定。其他温室气体总量控制与交易市场很可能也存在类似因素。（JEL D47, D81, Q54, Q58, R11）

title: Fuel Subsidy Pass Through and Market Structure: Evidence from the Renewable Fuel Standard
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: The Renewable Fuel Standard (RFS) is among the largest renewable energy mandates in the world. The policy is enforced using tradeable credits that implicitly subsidize biofuels and tax fossil fuels. The RFS relies on these taxes and subsidies to be passed through to consumers to stimulate demand for biofuels and decrease demand for gasoline and diesel. We study pass-through of the RFS subsidy for E85, a high-ethanol blend fuel, to retail fuel prices using weekly prices from over 450 fuel stations in the United States. We find that, on average, half to three-quarters of the E85 subsidy is passed through to consumers. However, pass-through takes 6–8 weeks, and station-level pass-through rates exhibit substantial heterogeneity, with the retailers’ market structure influencing both the speed and level of pass-through.
abstract_zh: 可再生燃料标准（RFS）是世界上规模最大的可再生能源强制性政策之一。该政策通过可交易的证书予以执行，实质上是对生物燃料进行补贴，并对化石燃料征税。RFS依赖于这些税收和补贴传导至消费者，以刺激对生物燃料的需求，并减少对汽油和柴油的需求。我们利用美国超过450座加油站的周度价格数据，研究了RFS对高乙醇混合燃料E85的补贴向零售燃料价格的传导。我们发现，平均而言，E85补贴的一半至四分之三会传导给消费者。然而，传导需要6至8周的时间，且加油站层面的传导率存在显著的异质性，零售商的市场结构同时影响着传导的速度和水平。

title: (Overly) Great Expectations: Carbon Pricing and Revenue Uncertainty in California
Rethinking Trade Exposure: The Incidence of Environmental Charges in the Nitrogenous Fertilizer Industry
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: The imposition of environmental regulations to domestic manufacturing traditionally creates concerns over the impacts of those regulations on international competition and downstream product prices. The US nitrogen fertilizer industry has been considered by conventional metrics to be one of the most vulnerable to such effects. Since 2010 the industry has undergone increased concentration of producers and a dramatic reduction in natural gas prices. Our research establishes that the pass-through of changes in prices to domestic natural gas declined from 80% prior to 2010 to effectively zero through 2014. One implication of this change in pricing dynamics is that the imposition of greenhouse gas (GHG) regulations on producers of nitrogen fertilizers would have little impact on fertilizer prices. Within the context of a GHG cap-and-trade program, the allocation of emissions allowances would likely result in a transfer to fertilizer producers on the order of hundreds of millions of dollars with no impact on fertilizer prices, emissions, or quantity consumed.
abstract_zh: 对国内制造业实施环境监管，传统上会引发人们对其在国际竞争和下游产品价格方面影响的担忧。按照常规指标，美国氮肥行业被认为是最容易受此类影响的行业之一。2010年以来，该行业的生产者集中度不断提高，天然气价格也大幅下降。我们的研究表明，在2010年之前，国内天然气价格变动的传导率为80%，而到2014年为止，该传导率实际上降至零。这种定价动态变化的一个含义是，对氮肥生产商实施温室气体（GHG）监管，对化肥价格的影响将微乎其微。在温室气体总量控制与交易计划的框架下，排放配额的分配可能会导致数亿美元量级的资金转移给化肥生产商，而对化肥价格、排放量或消费量没有任何影响。

title: State-level Strategic Policy Choice: The EPA’s Clean Power Plan
A Review of the Economics Literature on Electricity Restructuring
Electricity Capacity Markets at a Crossroads
venue: Davis Energy Economics Program Working Paper

title: Reforming the US Coal Leasing Program
abstract: About 40% of all coal mined in the United States is extracted from lands owned by the federal government, under leases managed by the U.S. Department of the Interior (DOI). Burning that coal accounts for 13% of U.S. energy-related greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions (1). With the largest and lowest-cost reserves in the United States, federal coal alone—estimated at nearly 10% of the world’s known reserves—has potential to contribute substantially to atmospheric CO2 concentrations (2). In response to calls for reform, DOI has issued a moratorium on new leases while it develops a Programmatic Environmental Impact Statement to guide the first major reform of the program since 1982. We review existing knowledge of key issues relevant to reform, highlighting the social costs of coal extraction, the extent of substitution away from federal coal induced by raising additional leasing revenue, the lack of competition in the leasing auctions, and the incentives inherent in the current leasing program structure. We then turn to critical areas of research that can be done in the near term and would contribute to more informed debate and policy development.
abstract_zh: 美国约40%的煤炭产自联邦政府所有的土地，这些土地依据内政部（DOI）管理的租约进行开采。燃烧这些煤炭占美国能源相关温室气体（GHG）排放的13%（1）。联邦煤炭资源拥有美国最大、成本最低的储量，仅联邦煤炭储量估计就接近全球已知储量的10%，因此有可能大幅提升大气中的二氧化碳浓度（2）。针对改革的呼声，内政部已对新租约实施暂停，同时正在编制一份项目环境影响评估（Programmatic Environmental Impact Statement），以指导自1982年以来该项目的首次重大改革。我们回顾了与改革相关的关键问题的现有知识，重点讨论了煤炭开采的社会成本、为增加租赁收入而引发的对联邦煤炭替代的程度、租赁拍卖中缺乏竞争的问题，以及当前租赁项目结构所固有的激励。随后，我们转向近期可开展、并有助于形成更知情的辩论与政策制定的关键研究领域。

title: The U.S. Electricity Industry after 20 Years of Restructuring
abstract: Prior to the 1990s, most electricity customers in the U.S. were served by regulated, vertically-integrated, monopoly utilities that handled electricity generation, transmission, local distribution and billing/collections. Regulators set retail electricity prices to allow the utility to recover its prudently incurred costs, a process known as cost-of-service regulation. During the 1990s, this model was disrupted in many states by "electricity restructuring," a term used to describe legal changes that allowed both non-utility generators to sell electricity to utilities -displacing the utility generation function -and/or "retail service providers" to buy electricity from generators and sell to end-use customers -displacing the utility procurement and billing functions. We review the original economic arguments for electricity restructuring, the potential winners and losers from these changes, and what has actually happened in the subsequent years. We argue that the greatest political motivation for restructuring was rent shifting, not efficiency improvements, and that this explanation is supported by observed waxing and waning of political enthusiasm for electricity reform. While electricity restructuring has brought significant efficiency improvements in generation, it has generally been viewed as a disappointment because the price-reduction promises made by some advocates were based on politically-unsustainable rent transfers. In reality, the electricity rate changes since restructuring have been driven more by exogenous factors -such as generation technology advances and natural gas price fluctuations -than by the effects of restructuring. We argue that a similar dynamic underpins the current political momentum behind distributed generation (primarily rooftop solar PV) which remains costly from a societal viewpoint, but privately economic due to the rent transfers it enables.
abstract_zh: 在20世纪90年代之前，美国大多数电力用户由受监管的纵向一体化垄断公用事业公司供电，这些公司负责发电、输电、本地配电以及账单与收款。监管机构设定零售电价，使公用事业公司能够收回其审慎发生的成本，这一过程被称为成本服务监管。20世纪90年代，许多州的这一模式因“电力重组”（electricity restructuring）而被打破。该术语指的是一系列法律变革，它允许非公用事业发电商向公用事业公司售电（取代公用事业公司的发电职能），和/或允许“零售服务提供商”从发电商购电并售给终端用户（取代公用事业公司的采购和账单职能）。我们回顾了电力重组的最初经济学论据、这些变革中潜在的赢家与输家，以及此后数年实际发生的情况。我们认为，推动重组最大的政治动机是租金转移，而非效率提升；政治上对电力改革热情时高时低的现象也支持了这一解释。尽管电力重组在发电方面带来了显著的效率改进，但它总体上被视为一种令人失望的结果，因为一些倡导者所承诺的降价，是基于政治上不可持续的租金转移。事实上，重组以来的电价变化更多地受外生因素（如发电技术进步和天然气价格波动）驱动，而非重组本身的效果。我们认为，当前分布式发电（主要是屋顶太阳能光伏）背后的政治势头也遵循类似的动态：从社会角度看其成本高昂，但由于其所促成的租金转移，从私人角度看却是有利可图的。

title: An Economic Perspective on the EPA’s Clean Power Plan
Downstream Regulation of CO2 Emissions in California's Electricity Sector
Nation-Wide Transmission Overlay Design and Benefits Assessment for the U.S.
Profiting from Regulation: An Event Study of the EU Carbon Market
abstract: Tradable permit regulations have recently been implemented for climate change policy in many countries. One of the first mandatory markets was the EU Emission Trading System, whose first phase ran from 2005-07.Unlike taxes, permits expose firms to volatility in regulatory costs, but are typically accompanied by property rights in the form of grandfathered permits. In this paper, we examine the effect of this type of environmental regulation on profits. In particular, changes in permit prices affect: (1) the direct and indirect input costs, (2) output revenue, and (3) the carbon permit asset value. Depending on abatement costs, output price sensitivity, and permit allocation, these effects may vary considerably across industries and firms. We run an event study of the carbon price crash on April 25, 2006 by examining the daily stock returns for 90 stocks from carbon intensive industries and approximately 600 stocks in the broad EUROSTOXX index. In general, firms in industries that tended to be either carbon intensive, or electricity intensive, but not involved in international trade, were hurt by the decline in permit prices. In industries that were known to be net short of permits, the cleanest firms saw the largest declines in share value. In industries known to be long in permits, firms granted the largest allocations were most harmed.
abstract_zh: 近年来，许多国家已为应对气候变化政策实施了可交易许可证制度。欧盟排放交易体系（EU ETS）是最早的强制性市场之一，其第一阶段运行于2005至2007年。与税收不同，许可证使企业暴露于监管成本的波动之中，但通常伴随着以免费分配许可证形式存在的产权安排。本文考察了这类环境监管对利润的影响。具体而言，许可证价格的变化会影响：（1）直接和间接的投入成本，（2）产出收入，以及（3）碳排放许可证的资产价值。取决于减排成本、产出价格敏感度和许可证分配方式，这些效应可能在不同行业和企业之间存在显著差异。我们以2006年4月25日的碳价格暴跌为事件，考察了来自碳密集型行业的90只股票以及欧洲斯托克600指数（EUROSTOXX）中约600只股票的日收益率，进行了事件研究。总体而言，那些碳密集型或用电密集型、但不参与国际贸易的行业中的企业，受到了许可证价格下跌的损害。在已知为净许可证短缺的行业中，最清洁的企业股价跌幅最大。在已知为许可证净持有的行业中，获得最多免费分配的企业受损最为严重。

title: Enforcement of Vintage Differentiated Regulations: The Case of New Source Review
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management

title: Regulation, Allocation and Leakage in Cap-and-Trade Markets for CO2
abstract: Among the most contentious elements of the design of cap-and-trade systems for emissions trading is the allocation or assignment of the emissions credits themselves. Policy-makers usually try to satisfy a range of goals through the allocation process, including easing the transition costs for high-emissions firms, reducing leakage to unregulated regions, and mitigating the impact of the regulations on product prices such as electricity. In this paper we develop a detailed representation of the US western electricity market to assess the potential impacts of various allocation proposals. Several proposals involve the “contingent” allocation of permits, where the allocation is tied to the output, or input use, of plants. These allocation proposals are designed with the goals of limiting the pass-through of carbon costs to product prices, mitigating leakage, and of mitigating the costs to high-emissions firms. However, contingent allocation can greatly inflate permit prices, thereby limiting the benefits of such schemes to high emissions firms. Rather than mitigating the impact on high carbon producers, the net operating profit of such firms can actually be lower under contingent allocation than under auctioning. This is due to the fact that product prices (and therefore revenues) are lower under contingent allocation, but overall compliance costs are relatively comparable between auctioning and contingent allocation. Thus, the anticipated benefits from contingent allocation are greatly reduced and further distortions are introduced into the trading system.
abstract_zh: 在总量控制与交易体系的设计中，最具争议的要素之一是排放配额本身的分配或指派。政策制定者通常试图通过分配过程实现一系列目标，包括减轻高排放企业的转型成本、减少向未受监管地区的碳泄漏，以及减缓监管对电力等产品价格的影响。本文构建了美国西部电力市场的详细模型，以评估各种分配方案的潜在影响。若干方案涉及许可证的“或有”分配，即分配量与电厂的产出或投入使用量挂钩。这些分配方案旨在限制碳成本向产品价格的传导、减少碳泄漏，并减轻高排放企业的成本。然而，或有分配可能大幅推高许可证价格，从而限制此类方案对高排放企业的益处。这类企业的净经营利润在或有分配下甚至可能低于拍卖方式下的利润，而非得到缓解。原因在于，在或有分配下产品价格（进而收入）更低，而两种方式下的总体合规成本相对可比。因此，或有分配的预期收益大大减弱，并给交易体系带来了进一步的扭曲。

title: The Economics of Carbon Offsets
venue: The Design and Implementation of U.S. Climate Policy
abstract: Although international programs for carbon offsets play an important role in current and prospective climate-change policy, they continue to be very controversial. Asymmetric information creates several incentive problems, include adverse selection and moral hazard, in offset markets. The current regulatory focus on additionality tends to paint all these problems with a broad brush without proper consideration of the context or their implications.
abstract_zh: 尽管国际碳抵消项目在当前及未来的气候变化政策中扮演着重要角色，但其仍然颇具争议。信息不对称在抵消市场中引发了若干激励问题，包括逆向选择和道德风险。目前监管层面对附加性（additionality）的关注，往往在未充分考虑具体情境及其影响的情况下，将所有这些问题一概而论。

title: Vertical Targeting and Leakage in Carbon Policy
venue: American Economic Review Papers and Proceedings
abstract: This paper examines the intersection between two aspects of climate policy design. The first is the point of regulation: should it be placed on pollution sources, carbon-rich inputs, or consumers? The second aspect concerns the external effects of a local climate policy. Leakage occurs when partial regulation results in an increase in emissions in unregulated parts of the economy. Our model demonstrates how directly regulating polluters can increase foreign emissions while indirect regulation (either upstream or downstream of the pollution source) will decrease foreign emissions. The net effect on combined domestic and foreign emissions will depend on market elasticities.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了气候政策设计中两个方面的交叉问题。第一个方面是监管的环节：应当将监管设置在污染源、富碳投入品还是消费者身上？第二个方面涉及地方气候政策的外部效应。当局部监管导致经济中未受监管部分的排放增加时，就会发生碳泄漏。我们的模型表明，直接监管污染者可能会增加境外排放，而间接监管（无论是在污染源的上游还是下游）则会减少境外排放。对境内与境外合计排放的净效应，将取决于市场弹性。

title: Adverse Selection of Emissions Offsets
venue: Energy Institute at Haas Working Paper

title: Building Blocks: Investment in Renewable and Non-Renewable Resources
venue: Harnessing Renewable Energy in Electric Power Systems

title: Upstream vs. Downstream CO2 Trading: A Comparison for the Electricity Context
The Guy at the Controls: Labor Quality and Power Plant Efficiency
venue: International Differences in the Business Practices and Productivity of Firms
abstract: This paper examines the impact of individual human operators on the fuel efficiency of power plants. Although electricity generation is a fuel and capital intensive enterprise, anecdotal evidence, interviews, and empirical analysis support the hypothesis that labor, particularly power plant operators, can have a non-trivial impact on the operating efficiency of the plant. We present evidence to demonstrate these effects and survey the policies and practices of electricity producing firms that either reduce or exacerbate fuel efficiency differences across individual plant operators.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了个体操作人员对发电厂燃料效率的影响。尽管发电是一项高度依赖燃料和资本的事业，但轶事证据、访谈和实证分析均支持这样一种假设：劳动力，尤其是电厂操作员，可以对电厂的运行效率产生不容忽视的影响。我们提供证据以证明这些效应，并考察了发电企业的政策与实践，这些政策与实践会缩小或扩大不同电厂操作员之间的燃料效率差异。

title: When it comes to Demand Response is FERC its own worst enemy?
Electricity Markets
venue: New Palgrave Dictionary of Economics and the Law

title: Implementation of California AB 32 and its Impact on Electricity Markets
abstract: California is considering the adoption of a cap-and-trade regulatory mechanism for regulating the greenhouse gas emissions from electricity and perhaps other industries. Two options have been widely discussed for implementing cap-and-trade in the electricity industry. The first is to regulate the emissions from electricity at the load-serving entity (LSE) level. The second option for implementation of cap-and-trade has been called the i¾‘first-selleri¾’ approach. Conceptually, under first-seller, individual sources (i.e. power plants) within California would be responsible for their emissions, as with traditional cap-and-trade systems. Emissions from imports would be assigned to the i¾‘importing firmi¾’. An option that has not been as widely discussed is to implement a pure source-based system within California, effectively excluding imports from the cap-and-trade system altogether. This article examines these three approaches to implementing cap-and-trade for Californiai¾’s electricity sector. The article discusses many of the issues relating to measurement and the impacts on bidding and scheduling incentives that are created by the various regulatory regimes.
abstract_zh: 加利福尼亚州正在考虑对电力行业以及可能的其他行业的温室气体排放实施总量控制与交易监管机制。针对电力行业实施总量控制与交易，有两种方案被广泛讨论。第一种是在负荷服务实体（LSE）层面监管电力排放。第二种方案被称为“第一销售者”（first-seller）方法。从概念上讲，在第一销售者方法下，加州境内的各个排放源（即发电厂）将对其排放负责，与传统的总量控制与交易体系一致。进口电力的排放将被归属于“进口企业”。另一种讨论较少的方案是在加州境内实施纯粹的基于排放源的体系，实际上将进口电力完全排除在总量控制与交易体系之外。本文考察了加州电力部门实施总量控制与交易的这三种方法。文章讨论了与计量相关的诸多问题，以及各种监管制度所产生的对竞价和调度激励的影响。

title: Inefficiencies and Market Power in Financial Arbitrage: A Study of California's Electricity Markets
abstract: For two years prior to the collapse of California's restructured electricity market, power traded in both a forward and a spot market for delivery at the same times and locations. Nonetheless, prices in the two markets often differed in significant and predictable ways. This apparent inefficiency persisted, we argue, because most firms believed that trading on inter‐market price differences would yield regulatory penalties. For the few firms that did make such trades, it was not profit‐maximizing to eliminate the price differences entirely. Skyrocketing prices in 2000 changed the major buyers' (utilities') incentives and exacerbated the price differentials between the markets.
abstract_zh: 在加州重组后的电力市场崩溃之前的两年里，同一时间、同一地点交付的电力同时在远期市场和现货市场进行交易。然而，两个市场的价格经常以显著且可预测的方式存在差异。我们认为，这种明显的低效率之所以持续存在，是因为大多数企业认为，利用市场间价格差异进行交易会招致监管处罚。对于少数确实进行此类交易的企业而言，彻底消除价格差异并不符合利润最大化。2000年价格飙升改变了主要买方（即公用事业公司）的激励，并加剧了两个市场之间的价格差异。

title: Local Solutions to Global Problems: Climate Change Policy Choice and Regulatory Jurisdiction
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy

title: Oligopoly Equilibria in Electricity Contract Markets
Vertical Arrangements, Market Structure and Competition: An analysis of Restructured U.S. Electricity Markets
abstract: This paper examines vertical arrangements in electricity markets. Vertically integrated wholesalers, or those with long-term contracts, have less incentive to raise wholesale prices when retail prices are determined beforehand. For three restructured markets, we simulate prices that define bounds on static oligopoly equilibria. Our findings suggest that vertical arrangements dramatically affect estimated market outcomes. Had regulators impeded vertical arrangements (as in California), our simulations imply vastly higher prices than observed and production inefficiencies costing over 45 percent of those production costs with vertical arrangements. We conclude that horizontal market structure accurately predicts market performance only when accounting for vertical structure.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了电力市场中的纵向安排。纵向一体化的批发商或签有长期合同的批发商，在零售价格预先确定的情况下，提高批发价格的动机较弱。针对三个重组后的市场，我们模拟了限定静态寡头均衡边界的价格。研究结果表明，纵向安排会显著影响估计的市场结果。如果监管者阻止纵向安排（如加州的做法），我们的模拟表明，价格将远高于实际观察到的水平，且生产低效所造成的成本将超过有纵向安排时生产成本的45%。我们的结论是，只有在考虑纵向结构的情况下，横向市场结构才能准确预测市场绩效。

title: A Dynamic Model of Investment in a Restructured Electricity Industry
California's Greenhouse Gas Policies: Local Solutions to a Global Problem?
abstract: California is in the process of implementing a broad portfolio of policies and regulations aimed at reducing greenhouse gas emissions. This paper summarizes the initiatives likely to impact the electricity generating sector. We present calculations showing that there is a substantial risk that two of the most prominent policies could simply result in a reshuffling, on paper, of the electricity generating resources within the West that are dedicated to serving California. This reshuffling is different from the conventional leakage problem as it involves no physical changes to the way electricity is generated across regulated and unregulated regions, but is instead driven by a contractual reshuffling of who buys power from whom. The problem is similar to an ineffective consumer boycott. The problem is still present but less severe if more Western states adopt carbon limitations. We also show that some of the least market-based initiatives, the renewable portfolio standards (RPS), are likely to have the biggest near-term impact on the carbon-intensity of electricity generation in the West. Thus the scale of RPS programs may be limiting the potential role of non-renewable options in reducing carbon emissions from the electricity sector.
abstract_zh: 加利福尼亚州正在实施一整套旨在减少温室气体排放的广泛政策和法规。本文概述了可能影响发电部门的各项举措。我们的计算表明，其中两项最突出的政策存在相当大的风险，可能仅仅导致西部地区专门服务于加州的发电资源在账面上发生重新分配。这种重新分配不同于传统的碳泄漏问题，因为它并不涉及受监管与未受监管地区之间发电方式的实际物理变化，而是由谁向谁购电的合同安排重组所驱动。这一问题类似于无效的消费者抵制。如果更多西部州采取碳限制措施，问题依然存在，但会有所缓解。我们还表明，一些最不依赖市场机制的举措，即可再生能源配额制（RPS），很可能在近期对西部发电的碳强度产生最大影响。因此，RPS项目的规模可能正在限制非可再生选项在减少电力部门碳排放方面的潜在作用。

title: Consumption under noisy price signals: a study of electricity retail rate deregulation in San Diego
abstract: Utility services employ nonlinear tariffs that attempt to convey information on cost convexities. This paper examines how customers respond to noisy and volatile tariffs by measuring deregulated retail rates' impact on electricity consumption in San Diego. When rates doubled in 2000, consumers appear to have reacted more to recent past bills than to current price information. By summer's end, we find consumption fell 6% while lagging price increases. Even months after the utility restored low historic rates customers continued curtailing demand. We conclude that rate structures relying upon lagged wholesale price averages produce delayed responses to scarcities or high costs.
abstract_zh: 公用事业服务采用非线性电价，试图传递有关成本凸性的信息。本文通过衡量放松管制后的零售电价对圣地亚哥电力消费的影响，考察了用户如何应对嘈杂且波动的电价。2000年电价翻倍时，消费者似乎对近期过去的账单反应更为强烈，而非对当前价格信息作出反应。到夏末，我们发现在电价上涨滞后的情况下，用电量下降了6%。即使在公用事业公司恢复了较低的历史电价数月之后，用户仍在持续削减需求。我们的结论是，依赖滞后批发价格平均值的电价结构，会导致对稀缺或高成本情况的反应滞后。

title: Electricity Resource Adequacy: Matching Policies and Goals
Looking for Trouble: Competition Policy in the U.S. Electricity Industry
abstract: In the aftermath of the California energy crisis, there has been a shift in the focus of electricity regulators away from the fostering of a competitive market structure and towards the application of regulations to specific market outcomes. Such a focus stands in marked contrast to the general principles governing competition policies in other industries. This shift is in part influenced by the clear failure of earlier attempts to establish a competitive market structure in California. But was this a failure of the policy, or of the tools that were used to implement it? In this chapter, I describe the tests historically used by regulators as screens for the potential abuse of market power by suppliers. More advanced methods, such as models of oligopoly competition, can potentially provide a much better understanding of the competitive outlook for a market. However, much uncertainty surrounds the development and application of such models. I apply an oligopoly model of the California market to actual market data to test the ability of such models to recreate true market outcomes. I also explore the potential impacts of structural changes in the California market on both the supply and demand-side. The results indicate that either a reduction in supplier concentration or an application of realtime pricing to end-users would have yielded cost savings on the order of billions of dollars during the summer of 2000. 1.0
abstract_zh: 加州能源危机之后，电力监管者的关注点发生了转变：从促进竞争性市场结构，转向对特定市场结果实施监管。这一关注点与其他行业竞争政策所遵循的一般原则形成了鲜明对比。这一转变在一定程度上受到加州早期建立竞争性市场结构的尝试明显失败的影响。但这究竟是政策的失败，还是实施该政策所用工具的失败？在本章中，我描述了监管者历史上用来筛查供应商滥用市场势力可能性的测试方法。更为先进的方法，例如寡头竞争模型，有可能更好地理解市场的竞争前景。然而，此类模型的开发与应用存在诸多不确定性。我将加州市场的寡头模型应用于实际市场数据，以检验此类模型重现真实市场结果的能力。我还探讨了加州市场的结构性变化在供给侧和需求侧可能产生的影响。结果表明，无论是降低供应商集中度，还是对终端用户实施实时定价，都可能在2000年夏季带来数十亿美元量级的成本节约。1.0

title: Ownership Change, Incentives and Plant Efficiency: The Divestiture of U.S. Electric Generation Plants
California's Electricity Crisis: a market apart?
Market Power in California's Gasoline Market
abstract: In recent months, prices for California's special (CaRFG) gasoline have again exceeded U.S. average prices by much more than the difference in production costs. A number of observers have attributed the widening average differential to increasing scarcity of refinery capacity among plants that are equipped to manufacture CaRFG gasoline. While these arguments have generally been sound, the dismissals of market power concerns have not been well supported. We study the potential for firms in the CaRFG wholesale gasoline industry to exercise market power, examining the refining, importation and storage of the fuel. We don't dispute arguments that the elevated prices are consistent with competitive markets, but we illustrate that the data are also consistent with some firms exercising market power. We then discuss methods for, and difficulties in, distinguishing between competitive pricing and market power.
abstract_zh: 近几个月来，加州特种汽油（CaRFG）的价格再次大幅高于美国平均价格，其幅度远超生产成本的差异。许多观察人士将平均价差的扩大归因于能够生产CaRFG汽油的炼油厂产能日益稀缺。尽管这些论点总体上是合理的，但对市场势力担忧的驳斥却缺乏充分依据。我们研究了CaRFG批发汽油行业中企业行使市场势力的可能性，考察了该燃料的炼制、进口和储存环节。我们并不否认高价格与竞争性市场相一致的论点，但我们说明，数据同样与部分企业行使市场势力相一致。随后，我们讨论了区分竞争性定价与市场势力的方法及其困难。

title: A Mixed Complementarity Model of Hydro-Thermal Electricity Competition in the Western U.S.
abstract: This paper presents a modeling framework for analyzing competition between multiple firms that each possess a mixture of hydroelectric and thermal generation resources. Based upon the concept ofa Cournot oligopoly with a competitive fringe, the model characterizes the Cournot equilibrium conditions ofa multiperiod hydrothermal scheduling problem. Using data from the western United States electricity market, this framework is implemented as a mixed linear complementarity model. The results show that some firms may find it profitable to allocate considerably more hydro production to off-peak periods then they would under perfect competition. This strategy is a marked contrast to the optimal hydroschedules that would arise ifno firms were acting strategically. These results highlight the need to explicitly consider profit-maximizing behavior when examining the impact ofre gulatory and environmental policies on electricity market outcomes.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个建模框架，用于分析多个各自拥有水电和火电发电资源组合的企业之间的竞争。该模型以带有竞争性边缘厂商的古诺寡头（Cournot oligopoly）概念为基础，刻画了多时段水火联合调度问题的古诺均衡条件。利用美国西部电力市场的数据，该框架被实现为一个混合线性互补模型。结果表明，一些企业可能会发现，将更多的水电出力分配到非高峰时段是有利可图的，其程度超过在完全竞争下的做法。这一策略与若没有企业进行战略性行为时所产生的最优水电调度形成了鲜明对比。这些结果凸显了在考察监管和环境政策对电力市场结果的影响时，明确考虑利润最大化行为的必要性。

title: Measuring Market Inefficiencies in California's Wholesale Electricity Industry
An Empirical Assessment of the Competitiveness of the New England Electricity Market
abstract: Underlying the current debates over the appropriate organization of the electricity industry and its wholesale markets is a need for metrics that allow for comparisons of the markets that are already operating. One such metric is provided by competitive benchmark analysis. The basic idea behind a competitive benchmark is to estimate the price that would result if no firm attempted to exercise market power and to compare it to observed market prices. In this paper we estimate competitive benchmark prices for the electricity market overseen by the Independent System Operator of New England (ISO-NE).We study the period from May 1999 to September 2001. Using the Energy Clearing Price (ECP) of the ISO-NE as a measure of market price, we find the demand-weighted markup between the ECP and the competitive benchmark to be 12%. However, the ECP reflects adjustments for factors, including transmission congestion and other unit operating constraints, that are not explicitly considered in forming our competitive benchmark. Alternative measures of market prices that more closely match our methods for estimating a competitive price can be derived by intersecting market demand with the aggregate supply curve taken from the offer prices of generation units. One such measure intersects the aggregate offer curve of all generation units with overall market demand. Using this measure of price, we find a demand-weighted markup of 4% over our estimate of competitive price. Another measure of price intersects the offer prices only of large fossil-fuel generation units with the actual demand served by that set of units. This price is usually higher than the previous offer-based measure because transmission and other operating constraints cause many fossil-fuel units to be called upon to operate even though their offer prices are higher than other units that are not operating. The margin produced from this latter offer-based measure is 11%. However this latter margin does not reflect ISO-NE's ex-post reduction of offer prices from certain transmission constrained units. Because of these reductions, the revenues earned by these units will be lower than indicated by this measure. It is extremely difficult to say how large the impact of ex-post market-power mitigation on this index is without more detailed data on specific mitigation events. The differences among these three measures indicate that factors other than energy bids play an important role in market outcomes in New England. Unit operating constraints are raising the ECP above the levels produced by a simple aggregation of energy bids. In addition, the set of units actually called upon to operate appears to be working larger margins into their energy offer prices than are reflected in the bids of other units. It is likely that the strategic bidding of other unit operating parameters, such Low Operating Limits (LOL) also plays a role in these outcomes. Other studies using similar methods have examined the competitive performance of the California and PJM electricity markets. The only time period over which all 3 studies overlap is May to December 1999. Over this period the performance of the New England market compares favorably to that of the California and PJM electricity markets. Further comparison of the New England and California markets during 2000 reinforces this impression. From the perspective of market efficiency the results to date are encouraging, particularly when compared to California, but need to be considered in context. The continued vertical integration of some suppliers and the transition contracts imposed on others provide a powerful mitigating influence on the incentives of these firms to exercise market power. The pending expiration of transition periods and potential consolidation of supply portfolios will reverse this effect. It is difficult to predict the extent to which new entry will offset these trends. The market power created by transmission congestion and other unit operating constraints presents an ongoing challenge to the efficient operation of electricity markets. Last, the operations, monitoring, and market power mitigation functions of the ISO no doubt has contributed to the outcomes detailed in this report. It is important that we continue to examine both the short and long term impacts of these activities, particularly as widespread changes to the ISO-NE's operations and pricing protocols are adopted.
abstract_zh: 当前关于电力行业及其批发市场应如何组织的争论，其背后需要一套能够对已经运行的各个市场进行比较的指标。竞争性基准分析便是其中一种指标。竞争性基准的基本思路是估计在没有任何企业试图行使市场势力的情况下会形成的价格，并将其与观察到的市场价格进行比较。本文估计了由新英格兰独立系统运营商（ISO-NE）监管的电力市场的竞争性基准价格。我们研究的时间段为1999年5月至2001年9月。以ISO-NE的能量结算价格（ECP）作为市场价格的衡量指标，我们发现，ECP与竞争性基准之间的需求加权加价率为12%。然而，ECP反映了对输电拥堵及其他机组运行约束等因素的调整，而这些因素在我们构建竞争性基准时并未被明确考虑。若要得到与我们估计竞争性价格的方法更为接近的其他市场价格衡量指标，可以将市场需求与由发电机组报价构成的总供给曲线相交。其中一种衡量指标是将所有发电机组的总报价曲线与整体市场需求相交。使用这一价格衡量指标，我们发现相对于我们估计的竞争价格，需求加权加价率为4%。另一种价格衡量指标则是将大型化石燃料发电机组的报价与该组机组实际服务的需求相交。该价格通常高于前一种基于报价的衡量指标，因为输电和其他运行约束使得许多化石燃料机组即使报价高于未运行的其他机组，仍被调度运行。由后一种基于报价的衡量指标得出的加价率为11%。然而，这一后一种加价率并未反映ISO-NE事后对某些受输电约束机组报价的下调。由于这些下调，这些机组所获得的收入将低于该衡量指标所显示的水平。若没有关于具体市场缓解事件的更详细数据，很难判断事后市场势力缓解对这一指数的影响有多大。这三种衡量指标之间的差异表明，除能量报价之外的其他因素在新英格兰的市场结果中发挥着重要作用。机组运行约束使得ECP高于简单加总能量报价所得到的水平。此外，实际被调度运行的机组似乎在其能量报价中加入了比其他未运行机组报价所反映的更大的加价。其他机组运行参数（如低运行限值（LOL））的战略性报价，很可能也在这些结果中发挥了作用。其他采用类似方法的研究考察了加州和PJM电力市场的竞争表现。这三项研究唯一重叠的时间段是1999年5月至12月。在此期间，新英格兰市场的表现优于加州和PJM电力市场。对2000年新英格兰与加州市场的进一步比较，强化了这一印象。从市场效率的角度来看，迄今的结果令人鼓舞，尤其是与加州相比，但需要在具体背景下加以审视。部分供应商持续的纵向一体化，以及对另一些供应商施加的过渡性合同，对这些企业行使市场势力的激励起到了强有力的缓解作用。过渡期的即将到期以及供应组合可能的整合，将逆转这一效应。很难预测新进入者能在多大程度上抵消这些趋势。输电拥堵及其他机组运行约束所产生的市场势力，对电力市场的高效运行构成了持续的挑战。最后，独立系统运营商的运营、监测和市场势力缓解职能，无疑也促成了本报告所详述的结果。我们必须继续考察这些活动的短期和长期影响，特别是在ISO-NE的运营和定价规程发生广泛变化之际。

title: Electricity Restructuring: Deregulation or Reregulation?
abstract: We discuss the lessons that can be gleaned from the experience with electricity restructuring to date. The gains from restructuring are most likely to occur through improvement in the efficiency and prudency of long-term investment, but these benefits will be very difficult to measure. Though restructuring could have near term benefits in the efficiency of production and consumption, concerns with the efficiency of decentralized dispatch and the exercise of market power make it at least as likely that restructuring will not benefit society in the short run. We argue that electricity is especially vulnerable to the exercise of market power, even by firms with relatively small market shares, so there will be continued need for regulatory oversight in these markets, at least until there is much more real-time demand responsiveness. Thus, restructuring in electricity markets is not now, and is unlikely to be, synonymous with deregulation.
abstract_zh: 我们讨论了迄今为止电力重组经验所能提供的教训。重组的收益最有可能通过提升长期投资的效率和审慎性而实现，但这些收益将极难衡量。尽管重组可能在生产和消费效率方面带来近期收益，但考虑到分散调度的效率问题以及市场势力的行使，重组在短期内同样可能无法使社会受益。我们认为，即使是市场份额相对较小的企业，也可能行使市场势力，电力市场尤其容易受到影响，因此，至少在实时需求响应大幅增强之前，这些市场将持续需要监管监督。因此，电力市场的重组当前并不等同于、也不太可能等同于放松管制。

title: The Competitive Effects of Transmission Capacity in a Deregulated Electricity Industry
abstract: In an unregulated electricity generation market, the degree to which generators in" different locations compete with one another depends on the capacity to transmit electricity" between the locations. We study the impact of transmission capacity on competition among" generators. We show that there may be no relationship between the effect of a transmission line" in spurring competition and the actual electricity that flows on the line. We then investigate the" equilibria that are likely to result as transmission lines between previously unconnected locations" are built and expanded. We demonstrate that limited transmission capacity can give a firm the" incentive to restrict its output in order to congest transmission into its area of dominance. This" analysis is applied to a model of California's forthcoming deregulated electricity market. Our" results indicate that at least one firm could have an incentive to strategically induce transmission" congestion and that relatively small investments in transmission may yield surprisingly large" payoffs in terms of increased competition.
abstract_zh: 在一个不受管制的发电市场中，位于不同地点的发电商之间的竞争程度，取决于各地点之间的输电能力。我们研究了输电能力对发电商之间竞争的影响。我们表明，输电线路在促进竞争方面的效果，与线路上实际流动的电量之间可能毫无关系。随后，我们考察了在原本未相连的地点之间修建和扩建输电线路时，可能形成的均衡。我们证明，有限的输电能力可能使一家企业有动机限制其产出，以使输电拥堵出现在其占主导地位的区域。这一分析被应用于加州即将实行的放松管制后电力市场的模型。我们的结果表明，至少有一家企业可能有动机战略性地诱发输电拥堵，而相对较小的输电投资可能带来出人意料的大额收益，表现为竞争的增强。

title: An Empirical Analysis of the Potential for Market Power in California's Electricity Market
abstract: We use demand and plant-level cost data to simulate competition in a restructured California electricity market. This approach recognizes that firms might have an incentive to restrict output in order to raise price and enables us to explicitly analyze each firm's ability to do so. We find that, under the current structure of generation ownership, there is potential for significant market power in high demand hours. During some months, congestion over Path 15, the primary in-state north-south transmission line, exacerbates the market power potential in northern California. While these results make deregulation of generation less attractive than if there were no market power, they do not suggest that deregulation would be a mistake. Nearly all markets exhibit some degree of market power. We find that the levels of hydroelectric production and the elasticity of demand are two of the most important factors in determining the severity of market power, having greater impact on equilibrium prices than the proposed divestitures of California's largest producers. These results indicate that policies promoting the responsiveness of both consumers and producers to price fluctuations can have a significant effect on reducing the market power problem.
abstract_zh: 我们利用需求数据和电厂层面的成本数据，模拟了重组后的加州电力市场中的竞争。这一方法认识到，企业可能有动机限制产出以抬高价格，并使我们能够明确分析每家企业这样做的能力。我们发现，在现行的发电资产所有权结构下，在高需求时段存在显著行使市场势力的可能性。在某些月份，加州境内主要的南北向输电线路Path 15上的拥堵，加剧了加州北部的市场势力潜力。尽管这些结果使放松发电管制的吸引力低于不存在市场势力的情形，但它们并不表明放松管制是错误的。几乎所有市场都在某种程度上存在市场势力。我们发现，水电出力水平和需求弹性是决定市场势力严重程度的两个最重要因素，它们对均衡价格的影响大于拟议中对加州最大发电商的资产剥离。这些结果表明，促进消费者和生产者对价格波动作出响应的政策，可以在减轻市场势力问题方面发挥重要作用。

title: Market Power in Electricity Markets: Beyond Concentration Measures
abstract: The wave of electricity market restructuring both within the United States and abroad has brought the issue of horizontal market power to the forefront of energy policy. Traditionally, estimation and prediction of market power has relied heavily on concentration measures. In this paper, we discuss the weaknesses of concentration measures as a viable measure of market power in the electricity industry, and we propose an alternative method based oil market simulations that take advantage of existing plant level data. We discuss results from previous studies the authors have performed, and present new results that allow for the detection of threshold demand levels where market power is likely to be a problem. In addition, we analyze the impact of that recent divestitures in the California electricity market will have on estimated market power. We close with a discussion of the policy implications of the results.
abstract_zh: 电力市场重组的浪潮在美国境内外都使水平市场势力问题成为能源政策的焦点。传统上，市场势力的估计和预测在很大程度上依赖于集中度指标。本文讨论了集中度指标作为衡量电力行业市场势力可行指标的弱点，并提出了一种基于市场模拟的替代方法，该方法利用了现有的电厂层面数据。我们讨论了作者此前开展的研究结果，并给出新的结果，以识别可能存在市场势力问题的需求阈值水平。此外，我们分析了加州电力市场近期的资产剥离将对估计的市场势力产生的影响。最后，我们讨论了这些结果的政策含义。

title: Transmission Rights and Market Power
Improving Private Incentives for Electric Grid Investment
Transmission Pricing in California's Proposed Electricity Market
Electric Grid Investment Under a Contract Network Regime
Electric Grid Investment: Can a Market do the Job?
Market Power in California Electricity Markets
Internal Auctions for the Efficient Sourcing of Intermediate Products
A Guide to the Blue Book: Issues in California's Electric Industry Restructuring and Regulatory Reform
Bidder Cost Revelation in Electric Power Auctions
Incentive Effects of Environmental Adders in Electric Power Auctions
abstract: We make a systematic examination of the options for incorporating environmental adders into auctions for non-utility generation. To date, adders have been a popular tool of some regulators for the planning process, but have not been embraced as a tool for operations. We argue that any rational implementation of adders into a competitive acquisition process will have at least an indirect effect on the operations of the resulting electric system. If adders are to be employed, regulators must therefore be comfortable enough with them to use them explicitly in both the operation and selection of generation resources.
abstract_zh: 我们系统地考察了将环境附加费纳入非公用事业发电拍卖的各种选择。迄今为止，附加费在一些监管者的规划过程中很受欢迎，但尚未被接受为运营工具。我们认为，任何将附加费纳入竞争性采购过程的理性做法，都至少会对由此形成的电力系统的运营产生间接影响。因此，如果要使用附加费，监管者必须对其有足够的把握，以便在运营和发电资源选择中明确地加以运用。
